item.title: UP Doesn’t Plan to Reconsider DART Vote
item.description: The DART board has approved funding and governance changes that it hopes will appease member cities seeking to withdraw from the transit agency. But University Park leaders say those moves won’t cause the city to rethink holding a special election this May.

item.title: Early Voting Underway in Texas
item.description: Early voting has begun in this year's primary election. During the early voting period, voters in Dallas County may vote at any countywide vote center. On Election Day, voting will be precinct-based, requiring voters to vote at their assigned party’s polling place.

item.title: Park Cities Crime Reports Feb. 9-15
item.description: No love for thieves, swindlers, and burglars was in the air this Valentine's Day in the Park Cities Crime Reports.

item.title: Bowlegged Lessons: My First Rodeo And Final Column
item.description: Not long after I moved to Dallas, I attended my first rodeo at the Cowtown Coliseum in Fort Worth and was electrified by the atmosphere.

item.title: Non-Credible Threat Prompts Investigation at Highland Park High School
item.description: Highland Park High School received a “vague threat” Wednesday morning that local law enforcement determined was not credible.

item.description: Highland Park wrestler Bennett Ham did what he has done at every tournament this season Saturday the UIL Texas Wrestling State Championships at the Berry Center in Cypress.

item.title: Bestselling Author to Deliver LitFest Keynote Tomorrow Night
item.description: The community is invited to hear bestselling author and screenwriter Blake Crouch deliver the Highland Park Literary Festival keynote speech tomorrow, Feb. 19, at Highland Park High School.

item.title: UP City Council Will Seek to Continue Paratransit Regardless of DART Vote
item.description: Even if University Park voters choose to withdraw from DART, the city will work to continue providing paratransit services to residents who need it.

item.description: Both the Hillcrest and W.T. White girls basketball teams qualified for the postseason out of District 13-5A.
